svg.title: Benchmark heatmap
svg.text: Benchmark: reached B, % of 20 layouts per cell (seed 0, synthetic 2.5D arena)
21 planners x 8 families x 2 sensor presets = 6720 flights. Source: samples/close-area-benchmark/results/matrix_0.json
Planner sees the true pose; prior-map rows read no scan, so they are an upper bound. One run = 5 percentage points.
